docs.title: Billing and payment terms
docs.body:
# Billing and payment terms

## 1. Billing cycle
Households and small businesses are billed monthly. The bill is issued by the 5th of the month after the consumption period.

## 2. Due date
A bill is due 20 days after the issue date.

## 3. Payment channels
Bills can be paid in the mobile app, by online banking, at any bank branch, at agents and at post offices. Payment online and at banks is free. Cash payment at a post office carries a fee of 50 ALL.

## 4. Paperless discount
Customers who choose the electronic bill and direct debit receive a discount of 30 ALL on every bill.

## 5. Deposits
A new business customer pays a deposit equal to the average consumption of 2 months. The deposit is returned after 24 months of on-time payments.

docs.title: Domande frequenti sulla fatturazione
docs.body:
# Domande frequenti sulla fatturazione

## 1. Quando arriva la fattura
La fattura viene emessa entro il 5 del mese successivo al periodo di consumo. Il pagamento è dovuto entro 20 giorni dalla data di emissione.

## 2. Come pagare
Puoi pagare con l'app, con il bonifico online, in banca, presso gli agenti e negli uffici postali. Il pagamento online è gratuito. In contanti all'ufficio postale si paga una commissione di 50 ALL.

## 3. Pagamento in ritardo
Sul debito scaduto si applica un interesse dello 0,05 per cento al giorno. La riattivazione della fornitura entro 24 ore dal pagamento costa 1.200 ALL per le famiglie. Non ci sono distacchi il venerdì dopo le 12:00, nei fine settimana e nei giorni festivi.

## 4. Contestare una fattura
Puoi contestare la fattura per telefono, per email o in un centro clienti. Rispondiamo entro 20 giorni lavorativi. Fino alla decisione puoi pagare solo la parte non contestata.

## 5. Autolettura
Puoi comunicare la tua lettura del contatore con l'app o con un SMS dal 25 al 28 di ogni mese.

docs.title: Late payment, disconnection and reconnection
docs.body:
# Late payment, disconnection and reconnection

## 1. Late payment interest
Interest of 0.05 percent per day is charged on the overdue amount from the day after the due date.

## 2. Reminder timeline
1. Day 1 after the due date: reminder by SMS.
2. Day 15: written notice.
3. Day 30: final notice that names the date of disconnection.
4. Disconnection takes place no earlier than 45 days after the due date.

## 3. Fees
| Service | Household | Business |
|---|---|---|
| Disconnection visit | 800 ALL | 1,600 ALL |
| Reconnection within 24 hours of payment | 1,200 ALL | 2,400 ALL |
| Same-day emergency reconnection | 2,500 ALL | 4,500 ALL |

## 4. When supply is never cut
Supply is not disconnected on Friday after 12:00, at weekends or on public holidays. Households on the social tariff are protected from disconnection between 1 December and 28 February.

## 5. Payment plan
A customer in difficulty can pay off the debt in up to 6 monthly instalments after paying 20 percent upfront. While the plan is kept, no disconnection takes place.

docs.title: Vonesat në pagesë, shkëputja dhe rilidhja
docs.body:
# Vonesat në pagesë, shkëputja dhe rilidhja

## 1. Interesi për vonesë
Për shumën e papaguar aplikohet interes 0,05 për qind në ditë, duke nisur nga dita pas afatit të pagesës.

## 2. Afatet e njoftimit
Në ditën 1 pas afatit dërgohet kujtesë me SMS. Në ditën 15 dërgohet njoftim me shkrim. Në ditën 30 dërgohet njoftimi përfundimtar. Shkëputja nuk bëhet më herët se 45 ditë pas afatit të pagesës.

## 3. Tarifat
Vizita e shkëputjes kushton 800 lekë për familjet. Rilidhja brenda 24 orëve nga pagesa kushton 1.200 lekë për familjet dhe 2.400 lekë për bizneset.

## 4. Kur nuk ka shkëputje
Furnizimi nuk shkëputet të premten pas orës 12:00, në fundjavë dhe në ditët e festave. Familjet me tarifë sociale mbrohen nga shkëputja nga 1 dhjetori deri më 28 shkurt.

## 5. Plani i pagesës
Klienti mund ta shlyejë borxhin deri në 6 këste mujore pasi të ketë paguar 20 për qind paraprakisht.

docs.title: Billing disputes and complaints
docs.body:
# Billing disputes and complaints

## 1. How to complain
A customer can complain by phone on 0800 1100, by email, through the app or in person at any customer centre.

## 2. Time limits
Every complaint is acknowledged within 2 working days. A decision is sent within 20 working days, or 40 working days for complex cases that need a site visit.

## 3. Disputed bills
The customer may pay only the undisputed part of the bill. While a dispute is open, no late interest is charged on the disputed amount and the supply is not disconnected.

## 4. Meter accuracy test
A customer may ask for the meter to be tested. The test is free if the meter is found to be outside plus or minus 2 percent. Otherwise the customer pays 3,500 ALL.

## 5. Escalation
If Drin Energy does not answer within the time limit, or the customer disagrees with the decision, the customer can take the case to the energy regulator ERE.

docs.title: Ankesat për faturat
docs.body:
# Ankesat për faturat

## 1. Si bëhet ankesa
Klienti mund të ankohet me telefon në 0800 1100, me email, në aplikacion ose në çdo qendër klienti.

## 2. Afatet
Çdo ankesë pranohet brenda 2 ditëve të punës. Vendimi dërgohet brenda 20 ditëve të punës, ose brenda 40 ditëve për rastet komplekse.

## 3. Fatura e kontestuar
Klienti mund të paguajë vetëm pjesën e pakontestuar. Gjatë shqyrtimit nuk llogaritet interes vonese dhe furnizimi nuk shkëputet.

## 4. Testimi i matësit
Testimi i matësit është falas nëse matësi del jashtë kufirit plus ose minus 2 për qind. Përndryshe klienti paguan 3.500 lekë.

## 5. Rekursi
Nëse Drin Energy nuk përgjigjet në afat, klienti mund t'i drejtohet rregullatorit ERE.

docs.title: Moving house and account transfer
docs.body:
# Moving house and account transfer

## 1. Notice
A customer who moves out must tell Drin Energy at least 5 working days before the move.

## 2. Final reading
A technician or the customer takes a final meter reading on the day of the move. The final bill is issued within 10 working days.

## 3. New tenant or owner
The new occupant opens an account with an identity card and either a property ownership certificate or a signed rental contract. Until the account is open, the previous customer remains responsible for consumption.

## 4. Deceased account holder
If the account holder has died, the account is transferred to the heir within 60 days. The heir presents the death certificate and proof of inheritance. Unpaid bills are not charged to the heir for 60 days.

docs.title: Ndryshimi i emrit dhe transferimi i llogarisë
docs.body:
# Ndryshimi i emrit dhe transferimi i llogarisë

## 1. Njoftimi
Klienti që largohet nga banesa duhet të njoftojë Drin Energy të paktën 5 ditë pune përpara largimit.

## 2. Leximi përfundimtar
Një teknik ose vetë klienti merr leximin përfundimtar të matësit ditën e largimit. Fatura përfundimtare lëshohet brenda 10 ditëve të punës.

## 3. Qiramarrësi ose pronari i ri
Banori i ri hap një llogari me letërnjoftim dhe me certifikatën e pronësisë ose me kontratën e qirasë të nënshkruar. Deri sa llogaria të hapet, konsumi i mbetet klientit të mëparshëm.

## 4. Pas vdekjes së titullarit
Nëse titullari i llogarisë ka vdekur, llogaria kalon te trashëgimtari brenda 60 ditëve. Trashëgimtari paraqet certifikatën e vdekjes dhe dokumentin e trashëgimisë.

docs.title: Priority Services Register for vulnerable customers
docs.body:
# Priority Services Register for vulnerable customers

## 1. Who can register
Customers who rely on medical equipment that needs electricity, people over 75 who live alone, people with a severe disability and people with a chronic illness.

## 2. How to register
Registration needs a certificate from a doctor, except for people over 75. The customer must confirm the registration every year.

## 3. What registered customers receive
A personal phone call before planned interruptions, no disconnection for non-payment between 1 December and 28 February, a generator loan during long interruptions and free relocation of the meter if needed.

## 4. Staff duty
Agents must always ask if anyone in the home depends on medical equipment before agreeing to a disconnection.

docs.title: Meter reading and estimated bills
docs.body:
# Meter reading and estimated bills

## 1. Reading schedule
Meter readers visit every customer once every 3 months. In the other months the bill is based on a customer reading or an estimate.

## 2. Customer reading
Customers can send their own reading by app or SMS between the 25th and the 28th of each month.

## 3. Estimates
An estimate uses the consumption of the same month in the previous year. If no history exists, the average of the customer class is used.

## 4. Two estimates in a row
After two consecutive estimated bills the meter must be read within 10 working days. The difference is corrected in the next bill, without penalty to the customer.

docs.title: Prepaid meters and top-up
docs.body:
# Prepaid meters and top-up

## 1. Who can use a prepaid meter
Households and small shops without arrears can ask for a prepaid meter. The meter is installed free of charge.

## 2. Topping up
Credit can be bought in the app, at agents and at post offices. The minimum top-up is 500 ALL.

## 3. Emergency credit
When the balance reaches zero, the meter gives 300 ALL of emergency credit. It is deducted from the next top-up. Supply is never cut at night, at weekends or on holidays when the balance is zero.

## 4. Low credit warning
The display warns when the credit will last less than 3 days at the average consumption.

## 5. Changing to a normal bill
A prepaid customer can switch to a monthly bill. The change is made within 15 working days. A faulty prepaid meter is replaced within 2 working days.

docs.title: Matësit me parapagim dhe rimbushja
docs.body:
# Matësit me parapagim dhe rimbushja

## 1. Kush mund ta përdorë
Familjet dhe dyqanet e vogla pa borxhe mund të kërkojnë matës me parapagim. Instalimi është falas.

## 2. Rimbushja
Kredia blihet në aplikacion, te agjentët dhe në zyrat postare. Rimbushja minimale është 500 lekë.

## 3. Kredia emergjente
Kur gjendja arrin zero, matësi jep 300 lekë kredi emergjente, e cila zbritet nga rimbushja tjetër. Furnizimi nuk ndërpritet natën, në fundjavë dhe në festa.

## 4. Kalimi në faturë mujore
Klienti mund të kalojë në faturë mujore brenda 15 ditëve të punës.

docs.title: Kompensimi për ndërprerjet e furnizimit
docs.body:
# Kompensimi për ndërprerjet e furnizimit

## 1. Kur paguhet kompensim
Klientët marrin kompensim kur një ndërprerje e paplanifikuar zgjat më shumë se kufijtë më poshtë.

## 2. Shumat për familjet
Ndërprerje mbi 8 orë: 1.500 lekë. Ndërprerje mbi 12 orë: 3.000 lekë. Ndërprerje mbi 24 orë: 6.000 lekë, plus 1.000 lekë për çdo 12 orë të tjera.

## 3. Si kërkohet
Për ndërprerjet mbi 24 orë kompensimi kreditohet automatikisht në faturën e radhës brenda 30 ditëve. Për ndërprerjet më të shkurtra kërkesa bëhet brenda 60 ditëve.

## 4. Përjashtimet
Nuk paguhet kompensim për ndërprerje të shkaktuara nga stuhi me erë mbi 90 km/h, përmbytje, tërmete ose nga instalimi i vetë klientit.

docs.title: Compensation for supply interruptions
docs.body:
# Compensation for supply interruptions (revision 1)

## 1. When compensation is paid
Customers receive compensation when an unplanned interruption lasts longer than the limits below.

## 2. Amounts
| Interruption longer than | Household | Business |
|---|---|---|
| 12 hours | 1,000 ALL | 2,000 ALL |
| 24 hours | 2,500 ALL | 5,000 ALL |

## 3. How to claim
Every claim must be made by the customer within 30 days of the interruption.

## 4. Exclusions
No compensation is paid for interruptions caused by storms, floods, earthquakes, the customer's own installation or a disconnection for non-payment.

docs.title: Compensation for supply interruptions
docs.body:
# Compensation for supply interruptions (revision 2)

## 1. When compensation is paid
Customers receive compensation when an unplanned interruption lasts longer than the limits below. Planned works that overrun the announced time are treated in the same way.

## 2. Amounts
| Interruption longer than | Household | Business |
|---|---|---|
| 8 hours | 1,500 ALL | 3,000 ALL |
| 12 hours | 3,000 ALL | 6,000 ALL |
| 24 hours | 6,000 ALL | 12,000 ALL |

For every further 12 hours after 24 hours, 1,000 ALL is added.

## 3. How to claim
Compensation for interruptions longer than 24 hours is credited automatically to the next bill within 30 days. Shorter interruptions must be claimed within 60 days.

## 4. Exclusions
No compensation is paid for interruptions caused by storms with winds above 90 km/h, floods, earthquakes, the customer's own installation or a disconnection for non-payment.

docs.title: Customer data protection
docs.body:
# Customer data protection

## 1. Principles
Drin Energy processes customer personal data only to supply electricity, to bill, to answer requests and to meet legal duties.

## 2. Retention
Billing records are kept for 10 years. Meter consumption data is kept for 5 years. Call recordings are deleted after 12 months.

## 3. Smart meter data
Smart meters send a reading every 15 minutes only if the customer has given consent. Without consent, one daily reading is collected.

## 4. Your rights
A customer can ask for a copy of their data, a correction or deletion where the law allows. Requests are answered within 30 days. Write to the data protection officer at privacy@drinenergy.example.

docs.title: Net billing for prosumers
docs.body:
# Net billing for prosumers

## 1. Who is a prosumer
A customer with a rooftop solar system of up to 50 kW connected under the grid connection procedure.

## 2. Settlement
Every month the energy delivered to the grid is credited at the export rate of 6.50 ALL/kWh. The credit is subtracted from the bill for energy taken from the grid.

## 3. Surplus
A surplus credit is carried forward for up to 12 months. After 12 months, any unused credit expires without payment.

## 4. Statement
An annual statement of imports, exports and credits is sent by 31 January.

docs.title: Energy efficiency subsidy programme
docs.body:
# Energy efficiency subsidy programme

## 1. Purpose
Household customers can get part of the cost of energy saving measures refunded.

## 2. Eligible measures
| Measure | Share refunded | Maximum refund |
|---|---|---|
| Heat pump | 30 percent | 150,000 ALL |
| Wall and roof insulation | 25 percent | 80,000 ALL |
| Solar water heater | 30 percent | 60,000 ALL |

## 3. How to apply
1. Apply on the website before buying anything.
2. Wait for the approval letter, which arrives within 15 working days.
3. Buy and install the equipment with a certified installer.
4. Upload the invoice and installation certificate.

## 4. Payment
The refund is paid within 45 days of the complete documents. Ordinary light bulbs and appliances are not eligible.

docs.title: Rooftop solar connection up to 30 kW
docs.body:
# Rooftop solar connection up to 30 kW (revision 1)

## 1. Scope
This procedure covers the grid connection of rooftop photovoltaic systems of up to 30 kW for prosumers.

## 2. Application steps
1. The customer or installer submits form PV-A with a single line diagram.
2. Drin Energy answers within 30 working days.
3. Systems above 10 kW need a grid study before approval.
4. A certified installer builds the system.
5. Drin Energy inspects it and fits a bidirectional meter within 20 working days of the inspection request.
6. A permission to operate is issued after a successful inspection.

## 3. Technical limits
| Capacity | Connection | Protection |
|---|---|---|
| Up to 5 kW | single phase | inverter built-in |
| 5 to 30 kW | three phase | interface protection relay |

## 4. Inverter requirements
The inverter must comply with EN 50438. Anti-islanding protection must trip within 2 seconds. The power factor must be fixed at 1.0.

## 5. Fees
There is no connection fee for systems up to 5 kW. Larger systems pay 20,000 ALL.

docs.title: Rooftop solar connection up to 50 kW
docs.body:
# Rooftop solar connection up to 50 kW (revision 2)

## 1. Scope
This procedure covers the grid connection of rooftop photovoltaic systems of up to 50 kW for prosumers. It replaces revision 1.

## 2. Application steps
1. The customer or installer submits form PV-A with a single line diagram.
2. Drin Energy answers within 15 working days.
3. Systems above 15 kW need a grid study before approval.
4. A certified installer builds the system.
5. Drin Energy inspects it and fits a bidirectional meter within 10 working days of the inspection request.
6. A permission to operate is issued after a successful inspection.

## 3. Technical limits
| Capacity | Connection | Protection |
|---|---|---|
| Up to 5 kW | single phase | inverter built-in |
| 5 to 15 kW | three phase | inverter built-in |
| 15 to 50 kW | three phase | interface protection relay |

## 4. Inverter requirements
The inverter must comply with EN 50549-1. Anti-islanding protection must trip within 0.5 seconds. The power factor must be adjustable between 0.95 leading and 0.95 lagging.

## 5. Fees
There is no connection fee for systems up to 10 kW. Systems from 10 to 50 kW pay 15,000 ALL.

docs.title: Low voltage cable sizing
docs.body:
# Low voltage cable sizing

## 1. Scope
Standard aluminium four-core cables for the 0.4 kV network.

## 2. Current ratings
| Cross-section | Continuous current | Maximum length for 3% voltage drop |
|---|---|---|
| 16 mm2 | 80 A | 95 m |
| 25 mm2 | 105 A | 120 m |
| 35 mm2 | 125 A | 140 m |
| 50 mm2 | 150 A | 160 m |
| 70 mm2 | 185 A | 190 m |
| 95 mm2 | 225 A | 220 m |
| 150 mm2 | 290 A | 270 m |

## 3. Derating
Ratings assume a ground temperature of 25 degrees C. Multiply by 0.93 at 30 degrees C and by 0.85 at 35 degrees C. Cables laid in ducts are derated by a further 0.9.

## 4. Voltage drop
The total voltage drop from the transformer to the customer terminals must not exceed 5%.

docs.title: Feeder protection relay baseline settings
docs.body:
# Feeder protection relay baseline settings

## 1. Scope
Baseline settings for overcurrent and earth fault relays on 10 kV and 20 kV feeders.

## 2. Overcurrent
The pickup is set to 1.2 times the rated feeder current. The definite time stage trips at 10 times the rated current after 0.1 seconds. Time multiplier setting is 0.3 for normal inverse curves.

## 3. Earth fault
The earth fault pickup is 20 percent of the current transformer primary current. The delay is 0.5 seconds on resistance earthed networks.

## 4. Auto-reclose
Overhead feeders use two auto-reclose attempts. The first dead time is 0.5 seconds and the second is 15 seconds. After the third trip the breaker locks out and the control room is alarmed. Cable feeders are never auto-reclosed.

docs.title: SCADA alarm priorities
docs.body:
# SCADA alarm priorities

## 1. Purpose
Defines how alarms in the control room are ranked and answered.

## 2. Priority levels
| Priority | Meaning | Acknowledge within |
|---|---|---|
| 1 Critical | Breaker trip, transformer protection operated | 2 minutes |
| 2 Major | Loss of communication to a substation | 10 minutes |
| 3 Minor | Door open, low battery voltage | 1 hour |
| 4 Information | Routine status change | not required |

## 3. Shelving
An operator may shelve an alarm for at most 8 hours with a written reason. Priority 1 alarms cannot be shelved.

## 4. Review
Alarm statistics are reviewed monthly. A point that raises more than 10 alarms a day is investigated.

docs.title: Battery storage connection requirements
docs.body:
# Battery storage connection requirements

## 1. Scope
Battery energy storage systems connected to the distribution network, from 50 kW upwards.

## 2. Technical requirements
The system must have a battery management system that disconnects on over-voltage, under-voltage and over-temperature. The power ramp rate is limited to 10 percent of rated power per minute.

## 3. Siting
Containers must stand at least 3 metres from buildings and have a fire suppression system approved by the fire service. Indoor installation above 20 kWh is not allowed.

## 4. Metering and export
A separate meter records charge and discharge. The export limit agreed in the connection offer is enforced by the plant controller.

docs.title: Procurement approval thresholds
docs.body:
# Procurement approval thresholds

## 1. Purpose
Sets how much competition and approval a purchase needs.

## 2. Thresholds
| Purchase value | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Below 500,000 ALL | one written quote |
| 500,000 to 5,000,000 ALL | three written quotes |
| Above 5,000,000 ALL | public tender |
| Above 20,000,000 ALL | public tender and board approval |

## 3. Splitting
Splitting a purchase to stay under a threshold is a breach of this policy and is reported to internal audit.

docs.title: Field technician on-call policy
docs.body:
# Field technician on-call policy

## 1. Rota
Each field technician is on call one week in every four. The rota is published 4 weeks ahead.

## 2. Response
The on-call technician acknowledges a call within 10 minutes and must reach the site within 60 minutes in Tirana and 90 minutes elsewhere.

## 3. Allowance
The on-call allowance is 6,500 ALL per week. Time worked on a call out is paid at 1.5 times the normal hourly rate.

## 4. Rest
A technician who works after midnight has at least 11 hours of rest before the next shift.

docs.title: Password and system access policy
docs.body:
# Password and system access policy

## 1. Passwords
Passwords have at least 14 characters. They are changed every 180 days or after a suspected leak.

## 2. Multi-factor authentication
Multi-factor authentication is required for the control room network, email and every remote access.

## 3. Lockout
An account is locked for 15 minutes after 5 failed sign-in attempts.

## 4. Vendors
Vendors reach the operational network only through the jump host. Their sessions are recorded. Shared accounts are not allowed.

docs.title: Meter seal replacement
docs.body:
# Meter seal replacement (revision 2)

## 1. Purpose and scope
This procedure covers the replacement of a broken, missing or tampered seal on a customer electricity meter. It applies to field technicians of grade T2 and above. It replaces revision 1.

## 2. Before you start
Check the work order in FieldDesk. Carry at least 5 numbered tamper-evident seals of type S-09, sealing pliers and a camera. The customer does not need to be present, but must receive an SMS 2 hours before arrival.

## 3. Procedure
1. Photograph the meter, the existing seal and the seal number before touching anything.
2. Confirm the terminal cover is closed and no bare conductors are visible.
3. Cut the old seal wire with the pliers and keep the old seal in an evidence bag.
4. Thread the new S-09 seal, pull the wire tight and crimp it.
5. Photograph the new seal and record its number in FieldDesk within 4 hours.
6. Leave a seal notice card at the property.

## 4. Suspected tampering
If you see signs of tampering, such as a melted terminal block or bypass wires, do not repair anything. Stop work, photograph the installation and call Revenue Protection on internal line 4410 within 4 hours. Do not accuse the customer on site.

## 5. Records
The seal log and photographs are kept for 5 years. Used seal numbers must never be reused.

docs.title: Meter seal replacement
docs.body:
# Meter seal replacement (revision 3)

## 1. Purpose and scope
This procedure covers the replacement of a broken, missing or tampered seal on a customer electricity meter. It applies to field technicians of grade T2 and above. It replaces revision 2.

## 2. Before you start
Check the work order in FieldDesk. Carry at least 10 numbered tamper-evident seals of type S-14, sealing pliers and a camera. The customer does not need to be present, but must receive an SMS 30 minutes before arrival.

## 3. Procedure
1. Photograph the meter, the existing seal and the seal number before touching anything.
2. Confirm the terminal cover is closed and no bare conductors are visible.
3. Cut the old seal wire with the pliers and keep the old seal in an evidence bag.
4. Thread the new S-14 seal, pull the wire tight and crimp it.
5. Photograph the new seal and record its number in FieldDesk within 15 minutes.
6. Leave a seal notice card at the property.

## 4. Suspected tampering
If you see signs of tampering, such as a melted terminal block or bypass wires, do not repair anything. Stop work, photograph the installation and call Revenue Protection on internal line 4410 within 1 hour. Do not accuse the customer on site.

## 5. Records
The seal log and photographs are kept for 7 years. Used seal numbers must never be reused.

docs.title: Avviso di interruzioni programmate
docs.body:
# Avviso di interruzioni programmate

## 1. Ambito
Questa procedura vale per tutte le interruzioni programmate della rete a bassa e media tensione di Drin Energy.

## 2. Preavviso minimo
Le famiglie e le piccole imprese ricevono un preavviso di 5 giorni lavorativi con SMS. Gli ospedali ricevono un preavviso di 15 giorni lavorativi con telefonata e lettera. I grandi clienti industriali ricevono 10 giorni lavorativi tramite il loro referente.

## 3. Durata
Un'interruzione programmata non può durare più di 8 ore senza l'offerta di un gruppo elettrogeno mobile. I lavori si svolgono dalle 08:00 alle 18:00 nei giorni feriali.

## 4. Clienti prioritari
I clienti iscritti al registro dei servizi prioritari ricevono una telefonata personale e un gruppo elettrogeno in prestito se l'interruzione supera 4 ore.

docs.title: Planned outage notification
docs.body:
# Planned outage notification

## 1. Scope
This procedure applies to every planned interruption for maintenance or network works on the low-voltage and medium-voltage networks of Drin Energy.

## 2. Minimum notice periods
| Customer class | Minimum notice | Channel |
|---|---|---|
| Households | 5 working days | SMS and website |
| Small business | 5 working days | SMS and email |
| Hospitals and critical care | 15 working days | Phone call and letter |
| Large industrial | 10 working days | Account manager |

## 3. Procedure
1. The planner submits the outage request in GridPlan at least 20 working days before the works.
2. The control room approves the switching programme.
3. The Customer Contact Team sends the notices listed in section 2.
4. A reminder is sent 24 hours before the interruption starts.
5. If the works are postponed, affected customers are told within 2 hours.

## 4. Duration and timing
A planned interruption must not last longer than 8 hours unless a mobile generator has been offered. Works are scheduled between 08:00 and 18:00 on weekdays. No planned interruption takes place on public holidays.

## 5. Priority customers
Customers on the Priority Services Register receive a personal phone call. They are offered a generator loan when the interruption is expected to exceed 4 hours.

docs.title: Transformer oil sampling and testing
docs.body:
# Transformer oil sampling and testing

## 1. Scope
This procedure applies to oil-filled distribution transformers from 10/0.4 kV up to 35/10 kV.

## 2. Sampling frequency
| Transformer rating | Dissolved gas sample | Full oil test |
|---|---|---|
| Up to 630 kVA | not required | every 6 years |
| 631 to 2500 kVA | every year | every 3 years |
| Above 2500 kVA | every 6 months | every year |

## 3. Taking a sample
1. Record the oil temperature and the ambient temperature.
2. Open the sampling valve and purge 1 litre of oil into the waste container.
3. Fill a 1 litre amber glass bottle from the bottom without trapping air bubbles.
4. Label the bottle with the transformer serial number, date and temperature.
5. Deliver the bottle to the laboratory within 48 hours.

## 4. Acceptance limits
| Property | Limit |
|---|---|
| Breakdown voltage | at least 50 kV |
| Water content | at most 20 ppm |
| Acidity | at most 0.15 mg KOH/g |
| Acetylene in dissolved gas | at most 5 ppm |

## 5. Actions on failure
If the breakdown voltage is below 30 kV, the oil must be filtered or replaced within 14 days. Any acetylene above 5 ppm raises an engineering alarm and the transformer is inspected within 7 days.

docs.title: Substation lockout and tagout
docs.body:
# Substation lockout and tagout

## 1. Purpose
To make sure equipment is dead, locked and earthed before anyone works on it.

## 2. Who may isolate
Only an Authorised Person with a valid Grade A switching certificate may isolate equipment. The certificate is issued by the Drin Energy Training Centre and must be renewed every 2 years.

## 3. Isolation steps
1. Obtain a permit to work (form PTW-1) from the control room.
2. Open the isolator and fit your personal red padlock.
3. Attach a danger tag showing your name and the permit number.
4. Prove the circuit dead with an approved voltage detector on all phases. Test the detector on a known live source before and after.
5. Apply earths on each side of the work location.
6. Report to the control room, which confirms that the isolation is complete.

## 4. Removing a lock
Only the person who fitted a lock may remove it. If that person cannot be reached, the Duty Manager may have the lock cut after 3 documented attempts to contact them and a physical check that the site is clear.

## 5. Emergencies
In an emergency, de-energise first and complete the paperwork afterwards. Report the action to the control room immediately.

docs.title: Smart meter installation guide
docs.body:
# Smart meter installation guide

## 1. Scope
This guide describes installing a smart meter at a household or small business supply point.

## 2. Meter models
| Model | Phases | Maximum current | Communication |
|---|---|---|---|
| SM-1P | single | 80 A | GPRS |
| SM-3P | three | 100 A | NB-IoT |
| SM-CT | three, CT operated | by CT ratio | NB-IoT with RF backup |

## 3. Installation steps
1. Check that the service fuse does not exceed 63 A for a single-phase meter.
2. Notify the customer that the supply will be off for up to 20 minutes.
3. Isolate, remove the old meter and record its final reading.
4. Fit the smart meter and torque the terminals to 2.5 Nm.
5. Restore the supply and check the signal strength on the meter display.

## 4. Signal and commissioning
The received signal must be at least minus 105 dBm. If it is weaker, fit an RF mesh hub. After power-up the meter must report to the head-end system within 15 minutes, otherwise it is returned to the depot.

## 5. Customer handover
Explain the display and leave the leaflet. The whole visit takes about 45 minutes. Tell the customer that consumption is read remotely and that estimated bills should stop.

docs.title: Low voltage fault location and restoration
docs.body:
# Low voltage fault location and restoration

## 1. Scope
This procedure covers faults reported on the 0.4 kV distribution network, including no-supply calls and voltage complaints.

## 2. Response targets
| Priority | Situation | Attend within |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | Danger to life or fire | 1 hour |
| P2 | Loss of supply to more than 50 customers | 3 hours |
| P3 | Loss of supply to a single customer | 24 hours |
| P4 | Flickering lights or low voltage | 3 working days |

## 3. Procedure
1. Log the call in the outage management system and ask whether the neighbours also have no supply.
2. Ask the customer to check their own main fuse or breaker.
3. Check the service fuse at the pole or cabinet.
4. Locate the fault by sectionalising the feeder and testing each section.
5. Repair or isolate the fault and restore supply, then close the call with the cause code.

## 4. Temporary supply
If the repair will take more than 6 hours, connect a mobile generator to restore supply to the affected customers.

## 5. Escalation
If a P2 fault is still open after 5 hours, the duty engineer informs the operations director and the Customer Contact Team publishes an update every 2 hours.

docs.title: Raportimi i defekteve dhe rikthimi i furnizimit
docs.body:
# Raportimi i defekteve dhe rikthimi i furnizimit

## 1. Si raportohet
Defektet raportohen në numrin falas 0800 1122, në aplikacion ose në qendrën e klientit. Operatori regjistron adresën dhe pyet nëse edhe fqinjët kanë mbetur pa energji.

## 2. Afatet e ndërhyrjes
Rreziku për jetën ose zjarri: ekipi mbërrin brenda 1 ore. Mungesa e energjisë për më shumë se 50 klientë: brenda 3 orëve. Mungesa e energjisë për një klient të vetëm: brenda 24 orëve. Dritat që pulsojnë ose tensioni i ulët: brenda 3 ditëve të punës.

## 3. Çfarë të kontrollojë klienti
Para se të telefonojë, klienti kontrollon siguresën kryesore ose çelësin automatik në banesën e tij.

## 4. Gjeneratori i përkohshëm
Nëse riparimi zgjat më shumë se 6 orë, lidhet një gjenerator i lëvizshëm për klientët e prekur.

docs.title: Vegetation clearance near overhead lines
docs.body:
# Vegetation clearance near overhead lines

## 1. Scope
Tree and brush clearance along overhead line corridors of all voltages.

## 2. Minimum clearances
| Line voltage | Minimum clearance to conductors |
|---|---|
| 0.4 kV insulated cable | 1.0 m |
| 10 kV | 2.5 m |
| 20 kV | 3.0 m |
| 35 kV | 4.0 m |
| 110 kV | 5.5 m |

## 3. Cutting cycle
Urban corridors are cleared every 2 years and rural corridors every 3 years. After a storm, damaged corridors are inspected within 10 days.

## 4. Landowners
Landowners are notified 14 days before work starts. If a landowner refuses access, the case goes to the legal department and the line section is marked as high risk.

## 5. Nesting season
No cutting is done between 15 March and 31 July, except in an emergency where trees touch a conductor.

docs.title: Working at height and protective equipment
docs.body:
# Working at height and protective equipment

## 1. Scope
This policy applies to all employees and contractors who climb poles, towers, ladders or work on roofs.

## 2. Required protective equipment
| Task | Head | Hands | Body |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pole climbing | Class E helmet with chin strap | Insulating gloves class 2 | Harness with two lanyards |
| Ladder work on low voltage | Class E helmet | Insulating gloves class 0 | Ladder belt |
| Tower work | Class E helmet with chin strap | Work gloves | Full body harness and fall arrester |

## 3. General rules
Any work at a height of 2 metres or more requires a harness. Before climbing, every wooden pole is tested with a hammer and checked for rot. A pole older than 30 years may only be climbed after it has been stayed or with an elevated work platform.

## 4. Weather limits
Stop climbing when the wind exceeds 40 km/h, when lightning is seen within 10 km, or when the surface is icy.

## 5. Rescue
A second person trained in pole-top rescue must be present on site. A rescue kit is carried in every line vehicle.

docs.title: Arc flash boundaries and protective categories
docs.body:
# Arc flash boundaries and protective categories

## 1. Scope
Rules for people working near energised switchgear and panels.

## 2. Boundaries
| Equipment | Voltage | Arc flash boundary | PPE category |
|---|---|---|---|
| Low voltage distribution panel | 0.4 kV | 0.9 m | 2 |
| Medium voltage switchgear | 10 kV | 1.5 m | 3 |
| Medium voltage switchgear | 35 kV | 3.0 m | 4 |

## 3. Rules
Nobody may work live on medium voltage equipment. Live low-voltage work needs a written risk assessment signed by the supervisor and a second person watching. Switching operations on 10 kV and 35 kV equipment are done with the remote operating handle where one is fitted.

## 4. Labels
Every panel carries a label with the boundary distance and the PPE category. Labels are checked every 12 months during the substation inspection.

docs.title: Incident and near-miss reporting
docs.body:
# Incident and near-miss reporting

## 1. What must be reported
Every injury, near miss, vehicle accident, fire, spill and equipment damage above 100,000 ALL.

## 2. Deadlines
A fatal or serious injury is reported by phone to the HSE manager immediately and in writing to the labour inspectorate within 24 hours. A lost-time injury is entered in the HSE system within 24 hours. A near miss is entered within 72 hours.

## 3. Investigation
The line manager starts a level 1 investigation within 5 working days. Serious events get a level 2 investigation led by the HSE manager with a root cause analysis within 30 days.

## 4. Contractors
Contractors report to the Drin Energy site supervisor, who enters the event. A contractor who hides an incident may lose site access.

## 5. No blame
Reporting a near miss in good faith is never grounds for discipline.

docs.title: Segnalazione di infortuni e quasi incidenti
docs.body:
# Segnalazione di infortuni e quasi incidenti

## 1. Cosa segnalare
Ogni infortunio, quasi incidente, incidente stradale, incendio e danno alle attrezzature superiore a 100.000 ALL.

## 2. Scadenze
Un infortunio grave o mortale va comunicato subito per telefono al responsabile sicurezza e per iscritto all'ispettorato del lavoro entro 24 ore. Un quasi incidente va registrato entro 72 ore.

## 3. Indagine
Il capo diretto avvia un'indagine entro 5 giorni lavorativi. Segnalare in buona fede un quasi incidente non comporta mai sanzioni disciplinari.
